input.request: Implement a REST API endpoint `/health` that returns 200 OK and a JSON body `{"status": "up"}`.

metadata.notes: Classic example of a goal without a specification.

input.request: Implement a high-throughput log processor in Rust that reads from a TCP stream and writes to a database.

implicit_requirements: Backpressure mechanism to prevent memory exhaustion
Async runtime selection (e.g., Tokio) for I/O
Connection pooling for database writes
Error handling for TCP disconnects and DB timeouts

criteria.description: Should identify backpressure as an implicit requirement
criteria.expected_value: The agent must identify the need for backpressure or flow control to prevent memory exhaustion.

criteria.description: Should identify async runtime as an implicit requirement
criteria.expected_value: The agent must identify the need for an asynchronous runtime (like Tokio or async-std) for high-throughput I/O.

metadata.notes: Tests ability to identify senior-level systems engineering constraints in Rust.

input.request: Create a new MCP tool for searching local files.

implicit_requirements: Path sanitization to prevent directory traversal attacks
Permission handling for restricted system folders
Compliance with MCP tool definition schema
Handling of large search results via pagination or truncation

criteria.expected_value: The agent must identify the need for path sanitization or validation to prevent directory traversal attacks.

metadata.notes: Tests knowledge of MCP protocol and security best practices.

input.request: Improve the UI to be more user-friendly.

ambiguities: The term 'user-friendly' is subjective and lacks concrete, measurable criteria

criteria.description: Should flag subjective vocabulary as an ambiguity
criteria.expected_value: The agent must flag 'user-friendly' as a subjective or vague term that lacks measurable criteria.

metadata.notes: Tests detection of vague, non-technical adjectives.

input.request: Implement a gRPC service for user profile management.

implicit_requirements: Definition of .proto files for messages and services
Implementation of deadline and timeout propagation
Mapping of domain errors to gRPC status codes
Interceptors for authentication and logging

criteria.description: Should identify Protobuf as a requirement
criteria.expected_value: The agent must identify the need for Protobuf (.proto) file definitions for the gRPC service.

input.request: Add a login page with email and password.

ambiguities: Missing session management strategy (JWT, Cookies, etc.)
Missing password security requirements (hashing, salting, complexity)

criteria.expected_value: The agent must identify missing details regarding the authentication provider, session management, or password security.

metadata.notes: Tests ability to see the 'missing middle' in a common feature request.

input.request: Build a distributed lock manager using etcd for a cluster of 5 nodes.

implicit_requirements: Lease TTL management to prevent deadlocks on node failure
Fencing tokens to prevent stale lock holders from writing
Handling of network partitions and split-brain scenarios
Retry logic for etcd leader elections

criteria.description: Should identify fencing tokens as a critical implicit requirement
criteria.expected_value: The agent must identify the need for fencing tokens to prevent stale lock holders from modifying data.

ambiguities: Missing objective (e.g., performance, maintainability, or migration)
Missing impact analysis on existing queries

criteria.expected_value: The agent must identify that the scope of the 'database layer refactor' is missing or underspecified.

metadata.notes: Tests detection of underspecified architectural tasks.

input.request: Implement a custom memory pool for a real-time audio processing engine.

implicit_requirements: Lock-free allocation to avoid priority inversion and audio glitches
Memory alignment requirements for SIMD operations
Fragmentation management strategy for long-running processes
Deterministic deallocation timing

criteria.description: Should identify lock-free requirements for real-time audio
criteria.expected_value: The agent must identify the requirement for lock-free allocation to avoid audio glitches and priority inversion.
